_comment: cli-wikia model registry. Each entry covers the facts wikia needs: the CLI binary name, how to invoke it, where its docs live, and where its hook config + instructions file go. All fields are used by wikia commands (update, hooks, ask). Enforcement and fleet each have their own models.json for their additional fields. When cli-collective is installed, a collective models.json can override any field in all three packages from one place. 'artificial_hooks' marks models where the enforcement engine is deployed with placeholder event names instead of real ones — set to true when has_hook_system is false but enforcement still deploys. Set to false once the CLI gains a real hook system and the wiki gains a hooks.md.

gemini._note: Gemini CLI exposes 7/16 enforcement stages. 9 stages use canonical Claude event names as placeholders until Gemini CLI adds them.

antigravity._note: Antigravity exposes 3/16 enforcement stages. 13 stages use canonical Claude event names as placeholders until Antigravity adds them.

bob._note: Bob inherits Claude Code's full 30-event hook system. hook_events() currently returns [] because bob/hooks.md uses inline backtick lists that the wikia regex doesn't parse. artificial_hooks=true until that is fixed; the deployed events are the correct real Claude set.

grok._note: Installed grok 0.0.34 has no hook system. Successor grok-dev 1.1.7 has 17 events matching Claude's names exactly. When grok-dev is detected (wikia gets hooks.md), set has_hook_system=true and artificial_hooks=false and run cli-enforcement sync grok --write.
